_README: WHERE EACH ROOM ACTUALLY IS, in fractions of the whole sheet, read off the plan by eye against
a 5 % grid (exp-truth-boxes.py grid <stem>). This is the only ground truth in the scan tooling:
everything else scores the review boxes against each other, which cannot answer 'does the box
sit on the room'. Worth about a percent either way — enough to separate 'on the room' from
'half on the neighbour', not enough to rank two drawings a point apart.
Labels are the reader's own captions, so a drawing can be matched to a room. Where a sheet
repeats a caption (three balconies), the match is made on the READER's rectangle, which is the
same for every drawing being compared, so no drawing can win by claiming a different room.
ADD A SHEET ONLY BY LOOKING AT IT. Never copy these from a model reply — that is the thing
